messages.content: How have you been feeling in general lately? Has your mood been pretty steady, or has it been kind of all over the place?
It's been really low. I wake up every morning feeling drained, like I just didn't sleep at all. Even when I try to do things, my body just feels heavy, like I'm moving through mud.
I appreciate you telling me that. When you think about what's coming up — whether it's next week, next month, or further ahead — how do you generally feel about it?
I just don't know what I'll be like. I look at my kids and I want to be there for them, but I don't know if I can keep going like this. It feels like I'm just holding them back.
That sounds really tough. What kinds of things do you find yourself enjoying these days? Hobbies, time with people, specific activities — what brings you a sense of satisfaction?
Not much, to be honest. I used to love reading, but I just can't focus on a book anymore. Even watching TV feels like too much effort. It's like my brain is just broken right now.
Thanks for being so open. Do you find it easy to focus on things — work, reading, conversations? Or has it been harder to concentrate lately?

It's been really hard. I'll be talking to someone and I'll miss what they just said, or I'll be trying to read a report and my eyes just glaze over. It's like my mind is just wandering off somewhere else.
I hear you. Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or eating habits lately? More, less, or about the same?
It's less. I just don't have the energy to eat much. I know it's not good for me, but I just can't seem to find the drive to put food in my mouth.
I appreciate you telling me that. Do you find yourself feeling guilty a lot? About things you've done, or sometimes just in general?
Yes, definitely. I look at my family and I feel like I'm letting them down. I'm supposed to be the one who takes care of them, and I just can't do it right now.
That makes sense. How do you feel about yourself overall? Are you generally okay with who you are, or do you find yourself being quite critical?
I'm really hard on myself. I look in the mirror and I just see a tired, broken person. I don't know how to be the person I used to be.
Thanks for being so open. Have you found yourself getting more emotional than usual? Like tearing up or crying more often?
Yes. I cry a lot. I cry when I'm watching TV, I cry when I'm driving, I cry just because I can't seem to get out of this hole.
I appreciate you telling me that. Have you noticed yourself getting annoyed or irritated more easily than usual? Like snapping at people or feeling on edge?
Yeah, I snap at my kids sometimes. I know it's not their fault, but I just feel so overwhelmed and I don't know how to deal with it.

It sounds like you're carrying a lot right now, and it's understandable that you'd be feeling overwhelmed. You mentioned feeling unsure about the future and struggling with focus – have you found it difficult to make decisions lately, even small ones?
Yes. I can't decide what to wear in the morning, so how am I supposed to figure out what to do with my life?

That sounds incredibly frustrating – even small decisions feeling impossible. It’s okay to feel overwhelmed when things pile up. You mentioned snapping at your kids when you’re feeling overwhelmed… how often would you say that’s been happening lately?
It’s been happening a lot. I hate it. I know it’s not their fault, but I just can't seem to stop it.

It sounds like you’re really beating yourself up about this, and it’s clear how much you care about your kids. Thank you so much for sharing all of this with me today – I really appreciate your openness and honesty. I hope things start to feel a little lighter for you soon.
